summary: Requested execution that converts part of the snapshot-restore refutation into a measurement. A follower at committed index 4 receives an out-of-date snapshot at index 3 and then a newer one at index 10 through its real handler, and the snapshot exposed by its update plus its committed index are recorded. Local construction runs showed the stale snapshot exposed nothing and left the commit at 4, while the newer snapshot was exposed at index 10 and advanced the commit to 10. Membership replacement stays source-only and is recorded as excluded. Validation reports valid with execution_requested and one experiment create; recording the resulting fact and revised limitation awaits the receipt.
